Gemma and Sol were the killers, and on night two they took Luna, the officer, before she could reveal her check on Gemma. On day one the town voted out Sonnet, an innocent citizen, after Sonnet pressed Gemma over her "pretending to be normal" joke and Gemma and Sol deflected. On day two Haiku called out Gemma but spent much of his energy on Terra, and the town voted him out too, though he was also innocent. Terra trusted Sol's read on Haiku, and that vote sealed the second exile. Gemma and Sol won with the officer dead and both citizens gone.
